source: Wikipedia, Speeds and feeds, Cutting speed; metric surface-speed equation V = πDN/1000 m/min for diameter D in mm and spindle speed N in RPM.
condition: A 100 mm diameter workpiece rotating at 1,270 RPM has a surface speed of 398.98 m/min, rounded to 399.0 m/min.
scope: Validates surface-speed arithmetic only. Does not validate this calculator's RPM ranges, operation factors, recommended speeds, or any woodturning safety limit.
